title: First atelier door opened
body: The first Dé-light room. One sewing machine, two sketchpads, and a client who needed something for an event nobody else could dress her for.

title: First bride
body: The first wedding gown commission. Hand drawn, hand cut, three fittings. The bride still wears the veil to anniversary dinners.

title: First aso ebi build for a 30 person family
body: Thirty sets, four weeks, one tone. The build that taught Beulah how to dress a family as a single image.

title: First Pinterest pin crosses 10,000 saves
body: The pin nobody promoted. The first signal that the work was carrying further than the word of mouth.

title: 100,000 monthly saves
body: The Pinterest profile crosses 100,000 monthly saves. Beulah hires the second seamstress.

title: First diaspora order to the UK
body: Measurements over WhatsApp, video fitting, shipped to London. The diaspora chapter begins.

title: Pinterest crosses 600,000 monthly saves
body: The save count that triggered the build of this site. The brand has more reach than memory; the site fixes the memory layer.
